---
title: "Badges"
format: html
extensions:
  support-this:
    display: badge
    description: "Your support keeps this work going."
    platforms:
      github: coatless
      patreon: username
      ko_fi: username
      buy_me_a_coffee: username
filters: [support-this]
---

With `display: badge`, each link is a [shields.io](https://shields.io) badge showing the platform's logo, its name, and the account, in the platform's color. Badges match the ones many projects already show in their README.

The badges are images served by shields.io, so readers need a network connection to see them.

## Other formats

Badges are for HTML pages. RevealJS, Typst, Word, and PDF use the default [Icon, Platform & Username](qsupport-this-display-icon-platform-username.qmd) display instead.

The other display modes are [Icon, Platform & Username](qsupport-this-display-icon-platform-username.qmd), [Icon & Username](qsupport-this-display-icon-username.qmd), and [Text](qsupport-this-display-text.qmd).
